name: Kikurami Kami no Hime
source: A land god of the land Ashihara, who leads the Tayutai. She rules over the village Nakatsu, and thus the villager call her princess (hime). Together with [url=/c158180]Kageharu[/url], she tries to achieve coexistence between humans and Tayutai
